tagging_basis: OCR H432 numbered specification sections (lettered learning outcomes as evidence)

units.label: 1(a)
units.summary: Explain why the H-O-H bond angle is larger in ice than in gaseous water.
units.difficulty_basis: Needs lone pair repulsion and hydrogen bonding in two states

units.label: 1(b)
units.summary: State why scientists are concerned about methane release into the atmosphere.
units.difficulty_basis: Single recall of greenhouse gas effect

units.label: 1(c)
units.summary: Determine the formula of methane hydrate from the percentage of methane by mass.
units.difficulty_basis: Mole ratio from percentage composition, unfamiliar hydrate

units.label: 1(d)
units.summary: Calculate the volume of methane released from 1.00 kg of methane hydrate using the ideal gas equation.
units.difficulty_basis: Multi-step with ideal gas equation and unit conversions

units.label: 1(e)
units.summary: Suggest why industries are interested in methane hydrate.
units.difficulty_basis: Single recall of fuel use

units.label: 2(a)
units.summary: Calculate the enthalpy change of two reactions from calorimetry data and link them by Hess law.
units.difficulty_basis: Extended multi-step calculation with signs and units

units.label: 2(b)
units.summary: Determine whether the mass or the temperature change has the greater percentage uncertainty.
units.difficulty_basis: Standard percentage uncertainty calculation

units.label: 2(c)
units.summary: Suggest a modification that would reduce percentage errors in the calorimetry experiment.
units.difficulty_basis: Needs reasoned improvement of the procedure

units.label: 2(d)(i)
units.summary: Give the systematic name of NaNO2.
units.difficulty_basis: Single recall of oxidation number naming

units.label: 2(d)(ii)
units.summary: Use oxidation numbers to show which element is oxidised and which is reduced.
units.difficulty_basis: Oxidation numbers in unfamiliar nitrogen compound

units.label: 2(d)(iii)
units.summary: Construct the equation for sodium nitrite and sodium forming sodium oxide and nitrogen.
units.difficulty_basis: Balancing an unfamiliar redox equation

units.label: 3(a)(i)
units.summary: Determine the rate equation from initial rates data and calculate k with units.
units.difficulty_basis: Standard initial rates analysis with units

units.label: 3(a)(ii)
units.summary: Explain how to find activation energy graphically from k and T values.
units.difficulty_basis: Recall of Arrhenius plot and gradient

units.label: 3(b)
units.summary: Use electrode potentials to explain how manganese dioxide catalyses peroxide decomposition.
units.difficulty_basis: Unfamiliar catalyst argument using potentials and equations

units.label: 3(c)(i)
units.summary: Suggest the structure of peroxyethanoic acid.
units.difficulty_basis: Single structure from given functional group

units.label: 3(c)(ii)
units.summary: Calculate the amount of peroxyethanoic acid at equilibrium from Kc.
units.difficulty_basis: Kc rearrangement with volume conversion

units.label: 4(a)(i)
units.summary: Record burette readings and titres in a suitable format and calculate the mean titre.
units.difficulty_basis: Titration data handling to 0.05 cm3

units.label: 4(a)(ii)
units.summary: Determine molar mass and alkyl group of acid A from titration data and draw its structure with chiral centres.
units.difficulty_basis: Multi-step titration plus structure deduction

units.label: 4(b)(i)
units.summary: Write the equation for magnesium reacting with a hydroxy acid and state the type of reaction.
units.difficulty_basis: Acid metal reaction with organic structures

units.label: 4(b)(ii)
units.summary: Write the equation for formation of a cyclic dimer of a hydroxy acid and state the reaction type.
units.difficulty_basis: Unfamiliar ring forming esterification

units.label: 4(c)(i)
units.summary: Draw the structure of the picolinate ligand in the chromium complex.
units.difficulty_basis: Deducing the ligand from complex structure

units.label: 4(c)(ii)
units.summary: Calculate the mass of chromium(III) picolinate in a tablet from the mass of chromium.
units.difficulty_basis: Mole calculation needing formula mass of complex

units.label: 5(a)(i)
units.summary: Write the Ka expression for butane-1-thiol.
units.difficulty_basis: Standard expression in unfamiliar acid

units.label: 5(a)(ii)
units.summary: Write an equation for butane-1-thiol reacting with ethanoic acid to form a thioester.
units.difficulty_basis: Analogy with esterification in unfamiliar context

units.label: 5(a)(iii)
units.summary: Draw the skeletal formula of 3-methylbut-2-ene-1-thiol.
units.difficulty_basis: Naming applied to unfamiliar thiol

units.label: 5(a)(iv)
units.summary: Write an equation for propane-1,3-dithiol reacting with propanone to give a cyclic product.
units.difficulty_basis: Unfamiliar condensation with two functional groups

units.label: 5(b)
units.summary: Explain how chemical tests would distinguish six naturally occurring compounds from each other.
units.difficulty_basis: Extended plan with elimination across six compounds
